name: reveal
description:
Reveal an entity that exists but the player does not know yet: they notice it, are told
of it, or reach it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the unrevealed canon entity.

name: move
description:
Move an actor who actually changes location, or one item within the player's reach:
picked up, set down here, or handed to an actor here.

entity_id.description:
Exact id of the actor or item that moves; `player` is the played character.
An item must be one the player carries, or one loose at their location.

to_id.description:
Exact id of where it goes: for an actor the location they enter; for an item,
`player` to pick it up, an actor here with the player to hand it over, or the
player's own location to set it down.

name: gain_improvised_item
description:
Give the player an ordinary incidental object that is not in canon and is not worth a
canon entry of its own.

item_name.description: The object written out, such as 'a handful of gravel'.

name: add_trait
description: Put a lasting condition, skill, or frailty on an entity.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description:
Stable slug for the trait, such as `poisoned`; it shows written out, so
`battle-worn` appears as Battle Worn.

text.description: The constraint or benefit it puts on the entity, in prose.

name: remove_trait
description: Lift a lasting condition, skill, or frailty the fiction has ended.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Exact id of a trait the entity carries.

name: advance_thread
description: Move a storyline the scenario is tracking: where it stands now, or that it is over.

thread_id.description: Exact id of one thread in ACTIVE THREADS.

status.description: Where the thread now stands, or null to leave it as it is.

stage.description: Stable slug for the point it has reached, or null to leave it as it is.

tick.description: How many segments this fills on the thread's clock, when it has one.

note.description: Replace the thread's private bookkeeping note with what its new state means for play, or null to keep it.

name: unlock_exit
description: Open a locked way out of the player's location.

to_id.description: Exact id of the location the way leads to.

name: join_party
description: Put an actor into the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor joining, who must be here with the player.

name: leave_party
description: Take an actor out of the player's party when the fiction parts them.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor leaving.

name: roll_attempt
description:
Put one risky attempt to the highest die of a pool. The player's own attempt goes to
`stake_attempt` first; roll here directly only for an NPC's attempt, or when the player's
words already accepted the named risk.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor attempting this: the player, or an actor here.

goal.description: What the actor is trying to do and what they risk by trying, in one line.

skill.description: The skill on the actor's sheet this calls on, or empty for none.

helped.description: The circumstance that makes this easier — a skill, a piece of gear, the ground they hold, an ally's presence — in a few words. Empty when nothing does, and never alongside `helper_id`.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who helps with this — they roll their own skill die into the pool. Null when nobody helps.

helper_skill.description: The skill on the *helper's* sheet this calls on, or empty for none.

hindered.description: The circumstance that makes this harder, in a few words. Empty when nothing does.

luck_test.description: What bad luck might arrive alongside this. Empty for no test.

name: stake_attempt
description:
Name the risk of one attempt out loud and hand the player the choice to proceed or
revise, before anything is rolled.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor attempting this: the player, or an actor here.

goal.description: What the actor is trying to do and what they risk by trying, in one line.

skill.description: The skill on the actor's sheet this calls on, or empty for none.

helped.description: The circumstance that makes this easier — a skill, a piece of gear, the ground they hold, an ally's presence — in a few words. Empty when nothing does, and never alongside `helper_id`.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who helps with this — they roll their own skill die into the pool. Null when nobody helps.

helper_skill.description: The skill on the *helper's* sheet this calls on, or empty for none.

hindered.description: The circumstance that makes this harder, in a few words. Empty when nothing does.

luck_test.description: What bad luck might arrive alongside this. Empty for no test.

attempt.description:
The attempt exactly as it would be rolled; it is frozen here, so what the
player proceeds with is what rolls.

risk.description:
What a bad roll costs them, in one line, in your own words: the warning the
player reads before deciding.

name: settle_defence
description:
Settle the hit the player's own words just answered for: their item breaks and turns
it into a brief hindrance, or the hit lands in full.

item_id.description:
Exact id of the carried, unbroken item their words break, or null when they
take the hit instead.

name: roll_luck_test
description: Put the SRD's standalone bad-luck test to the dice.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor whose luck is tested: the player, or an actor here.

subject.description: What bad luck might arrive — running out of ammo, running into guards.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor: the player, or an actor here.

amount.description: Positive to pay them, negative to charge them.

name: complete_chapter
description: Record that the job this crew has been running is done.
